name: Kali Temple
town_description: Kumbi is a small market town in Bishnupur district, Manipur, a few kilometres south of Moirang near the Loktak Lake basin. It is a predominantly Meitei settlement serving the surrounding agricultural villages, with local temples and shrines typical of the valley's mixed Sanamahism and Vaishnavite Hindu religious landscape.

travel.airport: Bir Tikendrajit International Airport, Imphal (~45 km from Moirang; ~50 km from Kumbi)
travel.railway: Nearest major railhead is Dimapur (Nagaland), ~200 km; the nearest in-state station is Jiribam.
travel.road: Kumbi lies on the Moirang-Kumbi road network near the Tiddim Road, about 50 km from Imphal via Moirang; local buses and shared taxis from Moirang and Imphal.
